name: goldclaw
description: Goldclaw collaboration repo for Goldshore planning, MCP, and Cloudflare Worker experiments.

scripts.cortex:worker:check: npx wrangler@4.125.0 deploy --dry-run --env preview --outdir .wrangler-dry-run/preview && npx wrangler@4.125.0 deploy --dry-run --env prod --outdir .wrangler-dry-run/prod
scripts.build: npm --prefix workers/goldshore ci && npm --prefix workers/goldshore run check && node scripts/build-pages.js
